name: hard_race_v1
written: 2026-10-16 by the main session (Opus); checked with linear segments between the waypoints: pole_1 clearance 0.258 m, pole_2 0.356 m, box_1 0.26 m, no gate frame touched, path 16.69 m, height 0.6 to 1.6 m
units: metres at scale 1 (Crazyflie size). Multiply every coordinate and every size by the simulator's scale. Use scale 1 for a drone about 0.1 m wide, scale 4 for a drone about 0.5 to 0.7 m wide (as the PX4 + Gazebo base lap did with the x500). Say which scale you used.
frame: x forward from the start pad, y to the left, z up. The start pad is at (0, 0, 0). yaw_deg is the direction in which the drone must pass through the gate, 0 = +x, counter-clockwise positive.

obstacles.why: stands on the straight line from G1 to G2
stands on the straight line from G3 to G4
the path from G4 to G5 must climb over it

waypoints_hint.how: take-off to (0,0,0.8); for every gate, a point 0.35 m before its center along yaw, the center, and a point 0.35 m after; plus the detour points below, inserted after the gate named; then the end pad at height 0.8 and land. A smooth curve through these points is fine if it keeps at least 0.2 m (scale 1) from every obstacle and passes each gate opening.

lap_junction.written: 2026-10-19 (Kestrel): the way from the point after G7 to the point before G1 of the next lap
lap_junction.why: on 2026-10-18 the straight way from the end of lap 1 into lap 2 went through G7 backwards and the drone stuck on its frame; these points go round G7 on its west side, over the start pad, and come into G1 from behind

success: 7 of 7 gates passed in order through the opening, 0 contacts with gates or obstacles, landing on the end pad. Report the lap time, the largest tilt, the closest distance to each obstacle, and any gate missed.
